listing.name: Sonic the Hedgehog — 2013 mobile edition / RSDKv4 decompilation
listing.summary: Explore Sonic the Hedgehog — 2013 mobile edition / RSDKv4 decompilation and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Supply this game’s original assets
steps.instruction: Before first Play, copy the supported Data.rsdk assets from your own official Sonic the Hedgehog (2013) release beside RSDKv4.exe. Follow upstream’s linked mobile/Origins extraction instructions for that game. Use this game’s assets; Sonic 1 and Sonic 2 each keep their own installation and saves. No separate compiler or installer is needed for the published x64 player.

presentation.manual_preparation: Before first Play, copy the supported Data.rsdk assets from your own official Sonic the Hedgehog (2013) release beside RSDKv4.exe. Follow upstream’s linked mobile/Origins extraction instructions for that game. Use this game’s assets; Sonic 1 and Sonic 2 each keep their own installation and saves. No separate compiler or installer is needed for the published x64 player. Data.rsdk or unpacked Data/Bytecode, settings.ini, SData.bin/SGame.bin/UData.bin, user mods, log.txt and missing-assets usage.txt are declared for compatible runtime replacement and backup. Keep the original source files too. For an optional Android pre-forever save import, upstream says to copy your own matching SGame.bin as SData.bin; retain both originals before doing so. Custom redirected storage, modified runtime files or a combined/custom engine folder can use external registration. Runtime rollback carries current declared data; it does not rewind progress or guarantee old-runtime/mod compatibility. Existing external installations keep their files and runtime owner. No original-input, gameplay, minimum-environment or packaged Desktop acceptance is inferred from package/source inspection.
